fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on the new Miami city commission and the recent city commission election; discussion of sex crimes and proposals for prevention and policing, including debate over prostitution policy; coverage of gambling and press reporting about South Florida gambling figures; an article on a reported gambling concession involving Haiti and its implications for Miami tourism; and a reprinted medical report on cigarette smoking and lung cancer that the paper argues was suppressed by major newspapers. Also includes local civic/utility organization news, community notices, and advertisements.
